# Inconsistency between C(q,v)v + g(q) and nonLinearEffects in pinocchio3-preview with JointModelComposite; what did the original thread confirm?

> **Current answer:** The author used Translation+SphericalZYX with JointModelComposite, complete URDF, and fixed q/v to reproduce the inconsistency; the maintainer confirmed the issue was due to incomplete support of JointModelComposite at the time and stated the plan to fix it. No fixes were applied to the PR, version, or retest, and the issue remains open.
